notes.text: The glory of God was revealed “between the cherubim;” afterward called the shekinah, it abode in the holy of holies, the center of Israel’s worship. See Ex. 25:22; Ps. 80:1; Isa. 37:16.
Not Mount Carmel, but a place in the territory of Judah, near the hill-town of Maon.
